lakes.name: Parker Pond
lakes.clarity: Oligo-meso; 2021 avg Secchi 8.2 m (hist 7.4), TP 4.8 ppb (30MRWA)
lakes.motors: No HP cap; ski-legal (CMR ch.13 §07 absent)
lakes.blurb: 1,500+ quiet acres, 8 m water, one restricted launch, loons, conserved headlands — Squam energy with live inventory.

lakes.name: Echo Lake (Fayette)
lakes.clarity: 2024 avg Secchi 7.2 m (hist 6.6), TP 6.2 ppb (30MRWA)
lakes.motors: No restrictions (10-hp 'Echo Lake' is Mt. Desert's)
lakes.blurb: Deep, clear, wooded Fayette water with YMCA camp heritage; affordable frontage; ideal ski loops.

lakes.name: Lake St. George
lakes.clarity: Oligotrophic; 'crystal clear' (state park guide); salmon water
lakes.blurb: Spring-fed, island-dotted, state-park anchored, Liberty prices: camp $395K, lots under $120K. Best value archetype.

lakes.name: Peabody Pond
lakes.clarity: Avg Secchi 8.0 m, low P (LEA 2022); oligotrophic
lakes.blurb: Closest truly pristine water: 8 m clarity, forested, no commercial anything. Inventory rare — patience or assemblage.

lakes.name: Moose Pond
lakes.clarity: Main basin avg Secchi 7.7 m (LEA 2022); stable; no invasives
lakes.blurb: Three basins under Pleasant Mtn; classic kids-camp water (Winona/Wyonegonic). Tradeoff: ski-area base traffic.

lakes.name: Pleasant Lake (Otisfield)
lakes.clarity: DEP 'excellent' class; spring-fed; high transparency
lakes.blurb: Otisfield's quiet spring-fed gem; Seeds of Peace camp proves compound format. Tradeoff: tight inventory.

lakes.name: Clearwater Pond
lakes.clarity: Oligotrophic, 129 ft deep, wild lake trout; famously transparent
lakes.blurb: Franklin County's clearest big pond; forested, lightly developed. Tradeoff: small market, few services.

lakes.name: Panther Pond
lakes.clarity: 2022 avg Secchi 7.0 m; oligo-meso, 30-yr stable (RWPA)
lakes.blurb: Camp Agawam water: clear, wooded, 25 min off the pike. Tradeoff: Raymond growth pressure.

lakes.name: Porter Lake
lakes.clarity: Secchi 8.5–9.0 m 2017–21 (Porter Lake Assn); healthy
lakes.blurb: Nine-meter water almost nobody knows; native lakers. Tradeoffs: 527 ac, remote-feeling, micro market.

lakes.name: Highland Lake (Bridgton)
lakes.clarity: Avg Secchi 7.4 m (LEA 2022); mesotrophic
lakes.blurb: Clear, islanded, 16-mi shoreline; north half quiet. Tradeoff: village beach/downtown at south end.

lakes.name: Sheepscot Pond
lakes.clarity: TP 5–10 ppb, stable Secchi, no blooms ever (SLA/DEP); 150 ft deep
lakes.blurb: Big, deep, healthy Palermo water with fish hatchery pedigree. Tradeoff: plainer shoreline market.

lakes.name: Long Pond (Belgrade)
lakes.clarity: 2024 Secchi 5.3–5.6 m, 'good all season' (7 Lakes Alliance)
lakes.blurb: Deep, mountain-framed Belgrade classic; Castle Island charm. Tradeoff: summer boat traffic.

lakes.name: Maranacook Lake
lakes.clarity: 'One of the cleanest in Maine' (wiki); deep 118-ft south basin
lakes.blurb: Clean two-basin lake, easy Augusta logistics. Tradeoff: heavier year-round development.

lakes.name: Pocasset Lake
lakes.clarity: 2024 avg Secchi 6.16 m (hist 5.7); meso, stable (30MRWA)
lakes.blurb: Wayne village charmer, quiet and clear. Tradeoff: modest 600 acres for serious cruising.

lakes.name: Crescent Lake
lakes.clarity: 2022 avg Secchi 6.8 m; oligo-meso (RWPA)
lakes.blurb: Panther's connected twin; clear, calmer, camp-lined. Tradeoff: smaller water, Rt 85 exposure.

lakes.name: Great Pond (Belgrade)
lakes.clarity: 2024 Secchi 5.7 m, good season (7LA); minor June scums
lakes.blurb: The 'On Golden Pond' sea: huge cruising range, island camps. Tradeoff: liveliest Belgrade social scene.

lakes.name: Crawford Pond (Union)
lakes.clarity: 'Above average' quality; 57 ft deep; 100-Acre Island preserve
lakes.blurb: Midcoast sleeper with preserved island and clean water. Tradeoff: small, low turnover.

lakes.name: Keoka Lake
lakes.clarity: Avg Secchi 6.8 m (LEA 2022); meso
lakes.blurb: Waterford village postcard, quiet and clear. Tradeoff: just clears the size bar.

lakes.name: Square Pond
lakes.clarity: Meso, decent clarity (LSM); no bloom history
lakes.blurb: Closest qualifying Maine water to NYC; solid ski pond. Tradeoff: dense camp shoreline, weekend buzz.

lakes.name: Pemaquid Pond
lakes.clarity: Meso, mid-4s m Secchi (LSM); no chronic blooms
lakes.blurb: Long, quiet, oyster-country lake near Damariscotta. Tradeoff: clarity a notch below the leaders.

lakes.name: Wilson Lake (Wilton)
lakes.clarity: Meso-clear; 88 ft deep, wild salmonids (FOWL)
lakes.blurb: Deep, tidy Wilton lake with active friends group. Tradeoff: town at south end, modest acreage.

lakes.name: Lake Wesserunsett
lakes.clarity: Long-term Secchi 5.9 m; TP 8 ppb 'warrants concern' (LWA 2017)
lakes.blurb: Lakewood Theater lake; roomy and affordable. Tradeoff: phosphorus creeping toward bloom threshold.

lakes.name: Megunticook Lake
lakes.clarity: Clear meso; monitored since 1975 (MWA); no invasives
lakes.blurb: Camden Hills backdrop, Fernald's Neck preserve — the prettiest water here. Caveat: 6:45 drive, Camden pricing.

lakes.name: Damariscotta Lake
lakes.clarity: Meso ~5 m; Aug 2024 cyanotoxin advisory (south arm), cleared on retest
lakes.blurb: 14 miles of island-strewn midcoast water, alewife runs. Caveat: episodic localized cyanobacteria advisories.

lakes.name: Richardson Lakes
lakes.clarity: Secchi 4.5–7.5 m; 'no significant health concerns,' sparse development (RLHT 2024)
lakes.blurb: Wildest big water in scope; loon wilderness. Caveats: 7:00 drive, mostly leased timberland frontage.

lakes.name: Swan Lake
lakes.clarity: Clear salmon lake; oligo-meso (LSM)
lakes.blurb: State-park lake above Belfast; 350 camps, honest prices. Caveats: drive edge, dam-level politics history.

lakes.name: Trickey Pond
lakes.clarity: Avg Secchi 9.7 m (LEA 2022) — clearest in region
lakes.blurb: Caribbean-clear outlier. Caveat: 315 acres — under size bar, tight ski loops, tiny inventory.

lakes.name: Alford Lake
lakes.clarity: Clear oligo-meso (LSM); Alford Lake Camp water
lakes.blurb: Hope's clean, low-key lake with camp pedigree. Caveats: modest size, thin public data and inventory.

lakes.name: Messalonskee (Snow Pond)
lakes.clarity: 2024 Secchi 4.5 m, 'good all season' (7LA)
lakes.blurb: Nine miles of cruising water, cheapest big-lake frontage in Belgrades. Caveats: mid clarity, busy Oakland end.

lakes.name: Mousam Lake
lakes.clarity: Recovered: delisted from impaired 2006; clarity +3 ft vs 1990s (EPA)
lakes.blurb: Closest-in option with real depth. Caveats: 700-home shoreline, restoration-era water still mid-pack.
